lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 to 12 vertical white lines of varying contrast. Spacing is relatively equidistant across the mid-section, becoming narrower and more fragmented as they approach the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A distinct Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the second major anterior line segment, splitting approximately one-quarter down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several lines in the posterior third of the torso are discontinuous, appearing as dashed segments or terminating before reaching the mid-lateral line of the body mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots are visible on the lower lateral haunch, positioned in a near-horizontal arrangement.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the face (one near the eye, one on the mid-muzzle) and a prominent white horizontal band at the base of the neck/chest area.
